system.description: You once donned the crusader's cross and returned from the Holy Land, and others know it; you may have marched with Richard the Lion-Hearted, Andrew of Hungary or Emperor Frederick. This accomplishment grants you special standing and repute among knights, lords and ladies who never made the journey to Outremer; jongleurs may beg your tales and others your opinion on events in the Latin Kingdoms.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
